atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: defines design tokens (colours, fonts, spacing) that become CSS variables and utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: defines a custom variant, e.g. `@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *))`.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind: inlines the styles of existing utility classes into a custom rule.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: loads a plugin, e.g. `@plugin "@tailwindcss/typography"`.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: registers an extra path for class detection.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: defines a custom utility class.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: applies a variant to the styles in a block.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind: points at a legacy JavaScript config file.
